sentence: A head-to-head knockout bracket where a group votes on each matchup between candidate stops until one winner is left.
use_when: A group needs to narrow a list of trip stops down to one pick or a few picks
People want to vote on pairs of options one matchup at a time
Someone asks to bracket, rank or settle a list of 2 to 8 choices
A host wants to add options first and then start the voting
dont_use_when: A single yes/no or one-shot poll is enough
The group needs a route, map or day-by-day itinerary
The list has more than 8 options or needs scored ratings
Splitting costs or tracking who owes what
